title: 第五章 小二初出手第六章 宴上露锋芒
content_zh:
何成局把书合上的时候，灶膛里的火已经灭了小半个时辰。厨房里冷了下来，但他手心是热的——丹田里那股气血稳稳地伏着，像一头吃饱了卧在草丛里的狼。
明天佛山来人。
余三娘说那客人手脚不规矩，点名要彭幼楚作陪。
何成局把这话在心里翻来覆去嚼了几遍。彭幼楚是他第一个下手的目标，也是全春香楼最不禁折腾的人。她最近几天好不容易气色好了点，要是再被一个手脚不规矩的客人折腾一晚上，怕是又要垮。
但他关心的不是彭幼楚的身子。他关心的是——彭幼楚体内那点微薄的阴气，是他何成局的私产。他隔几天去取一次，细水长流，稳稳当当。要是被一个不知轻重的客人糟蹋狠了，这口井就干了。
何成局站起身，把书塞进灶台砖缝，拍了拍手上的灰。
得想个办法。
第二天一早，何成局照常烧水煮粥。他今天劈柴的时候换了一把更重的斧头，单手抡了二十多下，胳膊只是微微发酸。五天前他劈这把斧头还要两只手，劈十下就得歇一歇。
他把斧头放下的时候，发现斧柄上多了几道裂纹——不是旧裂纹，是新的。他握斧的力道太大，把硬木斧柄攥裂了。
何成局面无表情地把斧头放回柴堆边上，换了把旧的继续劈。
早饭后余三娘把他叫到账房，交代今晚的排场：“佛山来的客人姓钟——不是钟铁山，是他一个远房侄子，叫钟世良。这人做的是铁矿石买卖，手头阔绰，但人品比钟铁山差了不止一筹。上次来的时候灌了幼楚三杯酒，把手伸到了不该伸的地方，被我一巴掌打了回去。”
何成局听着，点了点头。
“这次他又指名要幼楚，我不能不给。钟铁山的面子我得卖，但这个侄子要再乱来，你得给我盯着。”余三娘从抽屉里取出一根细长的藤条，递到何成局手里，“你今晚就站在雅间门口，他要只是灌酒你就别管，要是动了手——你就进去送酒，用这个敲他手腕。别敲太重，留个红印就行。”
何成局接过藤条，掂了掂，长短跟一根筷子差不多，柔韧而有弹性。“三娘，我一个跑堂的，打了客人怎么收场？”
“不用你收场，我来收。”余三娘端起茶杯，眼神淡淡的，“钟铁山讲规矩，他侄子不讲规矩在先，我替他管教，他能说什么？”
何成局把藤条收进袖子里，心里却在想另一件事——余三娘敢让他一个跑堂的去敲客人的手，说明她并不在意钟世良的反应。换句话说，钟世良虽是钟铁山的侄子，但在钟铁山心里的分量，恐怕还不如余三娘这个外人重。
这些弯弯绕绕的关系，何成局在春香楼六年看得太多了。
傍晚酉时刚过，钟世良就到了。
何成局在门口迎客，第一眼看见这人就觉得不太舒服——二十五六岁，穿着一身湖蓝色的绸衫，腰上挂着一块成色不错的玉佩，长相不差，但嘴角永远微微上翘，带着一种“天底下老子最大”的欠揍表情。他身后跟着两个随从，一个替他拎着礼盒，另一个腰间挎着刀，看步伐是个练家子。
“春香楼！又来了！”钟世良张开双臂，像是回到自己家一样大步跨进门槛，嗓门大得整条柳花巷都能听见，“幼楚呢？叫她下来，本少爷今儿个专门为她来的！”

何成局弯腰引路，嘴上说着“钟少爷里边请，雅间已经给您备好了”，眼睛却扫了一眼那个挎刀的随从。那随从三十出头，太阳穴微微鼓起，站姿稳得像钉在地上——至少是个炼体境，层次看不出来，但肯定比黄彪强。
何成局引着钟世良上了二楼雅间。彭幼楚已经在里面等着了，她今天穿着一件淡青色的衫子，头发用一根素银簪子挽着，脸上薄薄施了一层粉，看起来气色比前几天好了不少。但何成局注意到她交叠在膝上的手指在微微发抖。
“幼楚！”钟世良一进门眼睛就亮了，三步并作两步走到她身边坐下，一只手直接就往她肩膀上搭。
彭幼楚整个人僵住了，像一只被捏住壳的蜗牛，往椅子里缩了缩。
“钟少爷，先点菜吧。”何成局恰到好处地递上菜单，身子微微往前一挡，把彭幼楚隔在了身后。
钟世良被挡了一下，不耐烦地挥了挥手：“随便上，把你们这儿最好的酒菜都端上来。”然后他探出头绕过何成局，又去够彭幼楚的手。
何成局笑着应是，退出去的时候不动声色地把彭幼楚往靠窗的位置引了一下，让她离钟世良远了大半个身位。
他下楼去厨房端菜，在楼梯口碰到了张颜。
“那个姓钟的又来了？”张颜压低声音，脸上难得没有笑容，“上次他把幼楚灌吐了，幼楚哭了半宿。三娘怎么还接他的生意？”
“钟铁山的侄子。”何成局简短地回了一句。
张颜骂了一声很难听的，甩手走了。
何成局端着酒菜上了二楼。他把菜一道道摆上桌，酒斟满，然后退到雅间门口站定。袖子里那根藤条贴着前臂，凉凉的。
钟世良根本没把何成局放在眼里——一个小二而已，站在门口跟站在门外有什么区别？他自顾自地给彭幼楚倒酒，嘴里说着些没营养的恭维话，什么“幼楚姑娘越来越漂亮了”、“我上次来完回去想了你一个月”之类的。彭幼楚低着头，每次只抿一小口酒，话少得像在嘴里含了一块冰。
何成局不动声色地观察着。
钟世良灌了三杯酒下肚，话越来越多，手也开始不安分。先是想搭肩膀，彭幼楚侧身躲开了。然后是想摸手，彭幼楚把手缩进袖子里。钟世良脸上的笑容还在，但眼神已经有点不耐烦了——何成局认得这种眼神。他在春香楼见过太多次了，是那种“老子花了银子你就得让老子摸”的眼神。
第四杯酒下肚，钟世良的手直接往彭幼楚的腰上揽。
彭幼楚猛地站起来，退了一步，椅子腿在地上刮出一声刺耳的尖响。
“钟少爷，我……我给您弹个曲子吧。”她的声音在发抖。
“弹什么曲子，坐下陪我喝。”钟世良伸手去拉她。
这时候雅间的门开了。

何成局端着一壶新烫的花雕走了进来，脸上挂着标准的跑堂笑容：“钟少爷，热酒来了，给您换一壶。”
他走过来的时候步伐很自然，不紧不慢，刚好从钟世良和彭幼楚之间穿过。他把酒壶放在桌上的同时，身体微微一侧，再一次把彭幼楚挡在了身后。
“你先出去，没叫你进来。”钟世良皱眉。
content_en:
When He Chengju closed the book, the fire in the stove had been extinguished for half an hour. It was cold in the kitchen, but the palms of his hands were warm - the energy and blood in his Dantian lay steadily, like a satiated wolf lying in the grass.
Someone will come from Foshan tomorrow.
Yu Sanniang said that the guest was acting erratically and asked Peng Youchu to accompany him.
He Chengju chewed these words over and over in his mind several times. Peng Youchu was his first target, and he was also the person in Chunxiang House who couldn't help but torment him the most. She has finally looked better in the past few days. If she is tormented by an unruly guest for another night, she may collapse again.
But what he cared about was not Peng Youchu's body. What he cared about was that the meager amount of yin energy in Peng Youchu's body was his private property, He Chengju. He went to get it every few days, and the water flowed steadily and steadily. If it is ruined by an ignorant guest, the well will be dry.
He Chengju stood up, stuffed the book into the crack of the stove brick, and patted the dust on his hands.
Gotta find a way.
Early the next morning, He Chengju boiled water and cooked porridge as usual. When he was chopping firewood today, he changed to a heavier axe. He swung it more than twenty times with one hand, and his arm was only slightly sore. Five days ago he needed two hands to chop the axe, and he had to rest after ten strokes.
When he put the ax down, he found a few cracks on the handle - not old cracks, but new ones. He held the ax so hard that the hardwood handle cracked.
He Chengcheng expressionlessly put the ax back to the edge of the woodpile, replaced it with an old one and continued chopping.
After breakfast, Yu Sanniang called him to the accounting room and explained what was going on tonight: "The guest from Foshan is named Zhong - not Zhong Tieshan, but a distant nephew of his named Zhong Shiliang. This man is in the iron ore business and has a lot of money, but his character is much worse than Zhong Tieshan. When I came last time, I drank three glasses of wine from You Chu and put his hand where it shouldn't be, but I slapped him back."
He Chengju listened and nodded.
"This time he named You Chu again, and I have to give it. I have to sell Zhong Tieshan's face, but if this nephew messes around again, you have to keep an eye on me." Yu Sanniang took out a slender cane from the drawer and handed it to He Chengju's hand, "You will stand at the door of the private room tonight. If he just drinks, you can leave it alone. If he makes a move - you go in to deliver the wine and hit his wrist with this. Don't hit too hard, just leave a red mark."
He Chengju took the cane and weighed it. It was about the same length as a chopstick, flexible and elastic. "Sanniang, I'm just a waiter, what will happen if I hit a customer?"
"You don't need to finish it, I'll finish it." Yu Sanniang picked up the teacup and said with a faint look, "Zhong Tieshan follows the rules. His nephew is the first to not follow the rules. I will discipline him for him. What can he say?"
He Chengju put the cane into his sleeves, but he was thinking about another thing - Yu Sanniang dared him to knock the guest's hand as a waiter, which meant that she didn't care about Zhong Shiliang's reaction. In other words, although Zhong Shiliang is Zhong Tieshan's nephew, his weight in Zhong Tieshan's heart may not be as important as that of an outsider like Yu Sanniang.
He Chengju has seen too many of these twists and turns in his six years at Chunxiang House.
Just after the hour of unitary hour in the evening, Zhong Shiliang arrived.
He Chengju was greeting guests at the door. When he first saw this man, he felt uncomfortable - he was in his mid-twenties, wearing a lake blue silk shirt, with a good-quality jade pendant hanging on his waist. He looked good, but the corners of his mouth were always slightly upturned, with an expression of "I am the biggest in the world". There were two followers behind him, one was carrying a gift box for him, and the other was carrying a knife on his waist. Judging from his pace, he looked like an expert.
"Chunxiang Tower! Here we go again!" Zhong Shiliang opened his arms and strode into the threshold as if he were returning to his own home. His voice was so loud that the whole Liuhua Lane could hear it, "Where is Youchu? Tell her to come down. I am here specially for her today!"
He Chengju bent down to lead the way and said, "Master Zhong, please come inside. The private room is already here."It's been prepared for you." But his eyes glanced at the follower carrying the sword. The follower was in his early thirties, his temples were slightly bulging, and his posture was as stable as nails on the ground - at least he was in the body refining realm, and his level couldn't be seen, but he was definitely stronger than Huang Biao.
He Chengju led Zhong Shiliang to the private room on the second floor. Peng Youchu is already waiting inside. She is wearing a light cyan shirt today, her hair is tied with a plain silver hairpin, and she has a thin layer of powder on her face. She looks much better than the past few days. But He Chengju noticed that her fingers folded on her knees were trembling slightly.
"Youchu! "Zhong Shiliang's eyes lit up as soon as he entered the door. He walked to her side in three steps and sat down, and put a hand directly on her shoulder.
Peng Youchu froze, like a snail whose shell was pinched, and shrank into the chair.
“Master Zhong, let’s order first. "He Chengju handed over the menu just in time, and moved forward slightly, blocking Peng Youchu behind him.
Zhong Shiliang was blocked for a moment, and he waved his hand impatiently: "Come up as you like, and bring over all the best wine and food you have here. "Then he stuck his head out to bypass He Chengju and reached for Peng Youchu's hand.
He Chengju responded with a smile. When he exited, he quietly guided Peng Youchu to the window seat, making her more than half a body away from Zhong Shiliang.
He went downstairs to the kitchen to serve food and met Zhang Yan at the top of the stairs.
"Is that man named Zhong here again? Zhang Yan lowered his voice, rarely without a smile on his face, "Last time he made Youchu vomit, and Youchu cried for half the night." Why did Sanniang still accept his business? "
"Zhong Tieshan's nephew. "He Chengju replied briefly.
Zhang Yan cursed loudly and walked away.
He Chengju went up to the second floor with wine and food. He put the dishes on the table one by one, filled the glasses with wine, then retreated to the door of the private room and stood still. The rattan in the sleeve felt cool against the forearm.
Zhong Shiliang didn't take He Chengju seriously at all - he was just a waiter, what was the difference between standing at the door and standing outside? He poured wine for Peng Youchu while minding his own business, saying some useless compliments, such as "Miss Youchu is getting more and more beautiful", "I missed you for a month after I came here last time" and the like. Peng Youchu lowered his head, taking only a small sip of wine each time, and spoke as little as if he had a piece of ice in his mouth.
He Chengju watched calmly.
Zhong Shiliang drank three glasses of wine, talked more and more, and his hands began to become restless. First, he wanted to put his arm around his shoulders, but Peng Youchu sidestepped away. Then he wanted to touch his hands, but Peng Youchu retracted his hands into his sleeves. The smile on Zhong Shiliang's face was still there, but his eyes were already a little impatient - He Chengju recognized this look. He had seen her too many times in Chunxiang Tower, and she had the look in her eyes that said, "I spent money on you, so you have to let me touch it."
After finishing the fourth glass of wine, Zhong Shiliang put his hand directly on Peng Youchu's waist.
Peng Youchu stood up suddenly and took a step back. The legs of the chair scraped on the ground with a sharp sound.
"Master Zhong, I... let me play a piece of music for you. ” Her voice was trembling.
“Play some music, sit down and drink with me. "Zhong Shiliang reached out to pull her.
At this time the door to the private room opened.
He Chengju walked in with a pot of freshly hot wine, with a standard waiter's smile on his face: "Master Zhong, here is the hot wine, let me change it to a pot for you. "
When he walked over, he walked very naturally and unhurriedly, just passing between Zhong Shiliang and Peng Youchu. While he put the wine bottle on the table, he turned his body slightly to one side, blocking Peng Youchu behind him again.
"You go out first, I didn't ask you to come in. "Zhong Shiliang frowned.
